risk_description: Complex bidirectional synchronization logic between local Isar (NoSQL) and remote Aurora (PostgreSQL) databases may lead to data inconsistency, orphan records, or 'last-write-wins' data loss during conflict resolution.
root_cause: Impedance mismatch between local document store and remote relational schema combined with disconnected operation requirements.
mitigation_strategy: Implement rigorous unit testing for conflict resolution algorithms. Design idempotent sync endpoints. Utilize a 'soft-delete' mechanism globally to prevent accidental data loss during sync. Introduce a robust checksum mechanism to verify data integrity post-sync.
contingency_plan: Implement a 'Force Pull' feature allowing users to overwrite local data with server state if corruption occurs.
monitoring_trigger: Sync error rate > 1% or detection of integrity constraint violations in backend logs.

risk_description: Failure to correctly handle asynchronous server-to-server notifications (webhooks) from Apple App Store and Google Play could result in users receiving free premium access or paid users losing access (churn risk).
root_cause: Complexity of handling diverse platform-specific subscription lifecycle events (renewals, cancellations, grace periods) and lack of idempotency.
mitigation_strategy: Implement cryptographic signature validation for all webhooks. Design webhook handlers to be strictly idempotent. Store raw webhook payloads in S3 for audit/replay capability. Use Amazon SQS DLQ for failed webhook processing.
contingency_plan: Develop a manual 'Restore Purchases' endpoint that queries the store APIs directly to reconcile user status.
monitoring_trigger: Webhook processing failure rate > 0.1% or SQS DLQ depth > 0.

risk_description: Google Books API rate limiting or IP blocking of the centralized backend proxy could render the book search feature non-functional for all users simultaneously.
root_cause: Centralizing all mobile client traffic through a single backend gateway creates a bottleneck and a single point of failure regarding external API quotas.
mitigation_strategy: Implement aggressive caching (Redis) for book metadata. Use Polly for exponential backoff and circuit breaking. Request quota increase from Google early. Implement fallback to a secondary book data provider if available.
contingency_plan: Enable client-side direct API calls (with restricted API keys) via feature flag if backend proxy is blocked.
monitoring_trigger: Circuit breaker open state or 429 Too Many Requests errors from Google Books API.

risk_description: Uncontrolled costs from OpenAI GPT-4 API usage and OpenSearch Serverless provisioning due to high user engagement or inefficient embedding generation strategies.
root_cause: Token-based pricing models combined with potentially frequent background job execution for embedding updates.
mitigation_strategy: Implement strict daily budget caps in Azure/OpenAI. Optimize embedding update triggers (only update on significant data change). Cache recommendation results. Use cheaper models (GPT-3.5-turbo) for non-critical tasks.
contingency_plan: Switch to a cheaper embedding model or disable the AI recommendation feature for Free tier users immediately.
monitoring_trigger: Projected monthly cost exceeds 80% of budget within the first 10 days.

risk_description: Skill gap in AWS CDK (TypeScript) combined with .NET backend and Flutter frontend requirements may slow down infrastructure provisioning and pipeline creation.
root_cause: Full-stack complexity requiring expertise in three distinct ecosystems (Dart, C#, TypeScript/IaC).
mitigation_strategy: Assign specific DevOps lead for CDK work. Utilize standardized AWS CDK constructs/patterns. Conduct early team workshops on the deployment architecture. Pair programming for infrastructure tasks.
contingency_plan: Simplify infrastructure to use AWS App Runner or Elastic Beanstalk temporarily if Fargate/CDK complexity blocks release.
monitoring_trigger: Sprint 1 velocity for Infrastructure tickets is < 50% of planned capacity.

risk_description: Performance degradation on lower-end Android devices due to heavy local database (Isar) operations and UI thread blocking during synchronization.
root_cause: Dart's single-threaded event loop being blocked by synchronous database calls or heavy JSON parsing during sync.
mitigation_strategy: Strict enforcement of `compute()` isolates for JSON parsing. Ensure all Isar DB operations are asynchronous. Profile app performance on low-end devices during development sprints.
contingency_plan: Refactor sync logic to process smaller batches of data to maintain UI responsiveness.
monitoring_trigger: Frame drop rates > 5% on reference low-end devices during sync operations.

risk_description: Data leakage regarding user PII (Personally Identifiable Information) in AI prompts or logging systems, violating GDPR/CCPA regulations.
root_cause: Sending user context to external LLM providers (OpenAI) without proper sanitization or anonymization.
mitigation_strategy: Implement strict PII sanitization middleware before calls to OpenAI. Ensure CloudWatch logs exclude request bodies containing PII. Configure data retention policies on OpenSearch.
contingency_plan: Trigger incident response plan for data breach; temporarily suspend AI features.
monitoring_trigger: Detection of email patterns or names in logs/AI payloads via automated scanning tools.
